units.source_text: 「女人們」的氣息已經圍繞我的全身，女性（不只限於妓女）會憑藉本能嗅出這種氣息，然後紛至沓來。

en.t: The scent of women had already surrounded my whole body, and women, not only prostitutes, would instinctively sniff out that scent and then come flocking to me.

units.source_text: 這種帶有猥褻、不光彩氣氛的「隨贈附錄」降於我身，好像比我想休養與安眠顯得更加醒目。

en.t: This free extra, carrying an obscene and disreputable air, had descended upon me, and seemed to stand out even more than my wish for rest and peaceful sleep.

units.source_text: 堀木也許半帶著奉承說出了這番話，使我痛苦地感覺到頗有道理。

en.t: Horiki may have said this half in flattery, but it made me painfully feel that there was a good deal of truth in it.
